operatorNotes: Two of the four started items (P:29 and P:30) resolved no host at all: each issued exactly one robots.txt request that ended in DNS_FAILURE with subtype DNS_NAME_NOT_FOUND, which the orchestrator reports as ROBOTS_UNREADABLE_ROOT. Both produced zero page evidence, which is what fired P5 after item 4.

The P2 robots arm counts those same two items (a ROBOTS_UNREADABLE_ROOT root terminal reason), so P2 stood at 2 consecutive and 2 of 5 against a threshold of 3. P5 fired first at its own threshold of 2 of 5.

Both zero-yield items are DNS-level, not policy-level: no robots.txt was read and no site refused anything. Whether that is a permanently unreachable host, a stale published website claim, or something a later capability could repair is a question for the adjudication, not for this record.
P:31 was never started. The gate refused to authorise it and running around a pause is not authorised.

A Clamshell Sleep / DarkWake transition occurred at 2026-09-23T22:06:44Z, 2m58s after the terminal P5 gate, when the lid was closed. No item, database write or sealed write was in flight, so no acquisition evidence is affected. The governed final validation was held rather than started under violated preconditions, the lid was reopened by the operator, and the complete host / database / ledger / P7 / exact-plan preflight was re-proved before the single validation run.
